_comment: Environment-specific Glue job runtime settings. Identity (region, project prefix, domain tag, catalog name) lives in config/project.env; the data contract lives in config/pipeline.json; anything Terraform creates is owned by Terraform. Do not restate those values here.

glue._job_bookmarks_note: Enabled in Phase 4. Requires orders to be read through Glue's own reader with a transformation_ctx; a plain spark.sql() read ignores bookmarks and this setting becomes a silent no-op. Dimensions are deliberately not bookmarked - a bookmark on customers or products would read zero rows on the second run and quarantine every order as an orphan.
